sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Remove the unconditional sh:or constraints that require supportingStructureAtOrAboveIceBeltUpperLimit=true whenever an upper end hasTerminationAboveSupportingStructure. The clause does not prohibit termination above a deck or stringer below the ice-belt upper limit; being at or above the limit is only a precondition for using ordinary frame scantlings or, for an intermediate frame, the horizontal-member alternative. Retain that qualification within those permission branches only.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The shape encodes only the basic attachment rule and omits the verified conditional provisions. Extend the frame-targeted constraint to represent termination above a deck or stringer, require that supporting structure to be at or above the ice-belt upper limit, represent permitted ordinary non-ice-strengthened scantlings for the part above it, and encode the intermediate-frame horizontal-member alternative including connection to adjacent main frames and same-scantlings evidence. Use the supplied canonical terms hasTerminationAboveSupportingStructure, supportingStructureAtOrAboveIceBeltUpperLimit, ordinaryFrameScantlingsUsed, hasHorizontalConnectionMember, connectsToAdjacentMainFrame, and sameScantlingsAsMainFrame on their authoritative owners, while retaining the deck/tank-plating/ice-stringer attachment alternatives and main-frame versus intermediate-frame applicability.

Replace the frame-wide sh:or applicability gate with separate shapes targeting mainFrame and intermediateIceFrame so a node typed as both cannot satisfy only the weaker intermediate alternative. Constrain hasUpperEnd as the singular required end (sh:minCount 1, sh:maxCount 1, with the applicable sh:node value shape) rather than qualifiedMinCount alone, which currently permits a conforming witness alongside other nonconforming ends and lets direct-attachment and termination conditions be satisfied by different ends. Also add sh:maxCount 1 to each frame-owned boolean evidence property to prevent contradictory true/false values; retain conditional minCount only where the selected alternative requires the evidence.

Remove the unconditional sh:or constraints that require supportingStructureAtOrAboveIceBeltUpperLimit=true whenever an upper end hasTerminationAboveSupportingStructure. The clause does not prohibit termination above a deck or stringer below the ice-belt upper limit; being at or above the limit is only a precondition for using ordinary frame scantlings or, for an intermediate frame, the horizontal-member alternative. Retain that qualification within those permission branches only.
